response.sql:
WITH combination_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.tradekind,
    a.translink,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY t.tradekind, a.translink
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    translink,
    record_count,
    record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share
  FROM combination_counts
),
with_average_share AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  AVG(record_count) AS average_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - average_share) AS average_margin_over_average_share
FROM with_average_share
WHERE share > average_share
GROUP BY tradekind;

assumptions.assumption: “Average share for their trader type” means the unweighted arithmetic average of the transaction-and-trader-type combination shares for that type; the margin is each qualifying combination’s share minus that average, averaged per type.
